why_best: This approach anchors vertical video with high-density visual context while preserving the primary upper region for live focal content.
why_bad: A full-screen graphic transition or static text block would destroy the sense of live immediacy and choke the narrow vertical framing.
trap: Expanding the element's vertical footprint too far upward will intrude upon the subject's framing, turning a sleek info band into a suffocating visual obstruction.
